thread:
hannah-marketing: Short brief 1: we need a compact launch visual kit for an upcoming webinar + outbound. Deliverables: hero slide, one-page benchmark primer, 6 micro-explainers, 14 social variants. Figma components + PNG/SVG exports + one short GIF for hero. Locales: en/de/es. Timeline: 5 days. Can design take?

drew-design: Can do. Need exact export specs and copy constraints. Also confirm animation style.

hannah-marketing: Priority 1) hero (landing + webinar banner) 2) primer (editable sparkline) 3) six micro-explainers (cache, batching, kv-cache, quant, routing, fallback) 4) social variants (mix of 1200x628, 1080x1080, 820x312). Brand: primary palette only; single accent usage. Copy limits: headline <=12 words, body <=20 words.

oki-creative: Style direction 1: flat geometric icons, 1px stroke, light texture on hero, small 2-frame token shimmer for hero GIF. I'll drop two motion frames. Prefer GIF for social; provide MP4 hero too.

drew-design: Proposed export spec:
- Hero: 1600x900 PNG @2x, GIF 800x450 loop, Figma slide with speaker placeholder
- Primer: 1200x628 PNG + layered PDF, editable sparkline layer
- Micro-explainers: 1080x1080 and 1200x628 PNGs, SVG icons, max 10w headline/18w body
- Social: PNGs + one 640x360 MP4 teaser for hero
Filename conv: launchkit_<asset>_<locale>_v1.<ext>
Agree?

maria-prodcopy: Copy rules: avoid absolutes and hard numbers. Use phrasing like "typical token savings" or "reduces per-token cost". I'll deliver copy tomorrow AM and add the small footnote: "Performance varies by model and workload." Also provide CTA variants: Register / Learn more / View benchmark.

vin-solutions: Engineering note: please avoid SLA-like language. Eng-ML will do a 15-min terminology pass when first mocks are in. For diagrams keep sequences to 3 steps and label tiers (low-cost, balanced, high-accuracy).

brandbot: Brand checklist: primary hexes #0A2540, #0B6FFF, #14D1A1. Fonts: Redwood Sans for headings/body, Redwood Mono for code. Contrast >= 4.5:1 for body. Use spacing tokens s-8 / s-16. Do not substitute fonts.

drew-design: Great. Owners: Drew - design lead; Oki - motion/creative; Maria - product copy; Vin - eng reviewer; Hannah - campaign owner. I'll spin up a Figma file, add a components page, and drop hero + 2 explainers by EOD tomorrow. I'll label frames for localization.

hannah-marketing: Perfect 1 thanks team. Tag me when first pass is live and add localization sheet to the Figma file. If anything blocks, flag early. :rocket:
